author: Bellular News
description:
Blizzard survived Xbox’s latest layoffs. After BlizzCon, it’s easier to see why. They’ve got games making money now and years of releases still to come. But good games haven’t stopped Xbox firing people before, and even Blizzard’s new union protections can only go so far. This may just have bought them time.

Join us at https://bellular.games for early access content, 20 editions of 'Loading Screen' a month and to support our team!
